mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ANNOUNCEMENT WHERE ID = #{id, jdbcType=DECIMAL}
mapper.select: SELECT ID, TITLE, CONTENT, TYPE, PUBLISHER_ID, PUBLISHER_NAME, STATUS, ATTACHMENTS, EXPIRE_TIME, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME FROM ANNOUNCEMENT WHERE STATUS = 'active' AND (EXPIRE_TIME IS NULL OR EXPIRE_TIME > SYSDATE) ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
